top_signals.title: Dollar Slumps to Start September as Yen Surges on Rate Bets
top_signals.summary: The dollar slumped to start September as traders cut bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike this month and a surging yen rippled across global currency markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Anwar’s Relations With Malaysia Deputy PM Zahid Are Said to Vastly Deteriorate
top_signals.summary: Relations between Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and his ruling alliance partner Zahid Hamidi have deteriorated in recent weeks, according to people familiar with the matter, with the two men barely seen talking to each other.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: London-listed oil driller suffers sharp sell-off over Milei Falklands threats
top_signals.summary: Rockhopper, an London-listed oil exploration firm, is battling to slow an investor sell-off after Argentina’s president vowed to sanction any oil companies working near the Falkland Islands. In a national address, Javier Milei emphasised Argentina’s claim over the British territory and promised to sanction any oil companies working there as part of the “British occupation”. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
